summary: All 17 G–M deploy repos' .architecturerc (and KubeCoderDeploy's architecture.yaml header) name what gen-architecture --help prints from the aac-tools toolchain; each is pushed and done under D1's batching (four batches of four plus KubeCoderDeploy c776662, which carried P5's mapping and starts no AaC build because that job polls prd). Ledger rows, done-record and a close-out A2 note are committed in AnsibleSpecs; the Ansible branch carries no commit; kc project test --project root is green.
